statement: Asked 291 prompts a person conceives, over 41 kinds from arithmetic and code to poems, riddles and small talk, the organism alone (no language model, no socket) answered 36 natively (12.37%) and said it does not carry the other 255 (87.63%); of the 263 prompts with a rubric that needs no model, 16 of its answers passed (6.08% strict, 6.08% under IFEval's loose reading), at a median 672500 ns per ask, 83500 ns per native answer. With its knowledge tier off, as on dilation.dev where no ingested store is deployed, it answered 27 (9.28%) and passed 12 (4.56%). It refuses every prompt of 34 of 41 kinds (units, sequence, counting, spelling, vocabulary, logic, calendar, geometry, explain, translation, summary, plan, advice, list, brainstorm, comparison, classification, rewrite, poem, story, joke, recipe, letter, riddle, opinion, essay, code, code-reading, sql, command, format, quiz, analogy, probability). Of the organism's native answers to prompts with a rubric, 8 of 24 failed it (given with confidence and wrong by the rubric: alg-01, alg-02, alg-04, word-08, fact-09, def-02, def-06, def-09). The organism with its model cell was not measured in this run (not requested: without --model-arm this bench opens no socket; board 31 runs every item MODEL OFF (the one ollama queue is held by the orchestrator's rungs), so the model arm waits for a free queue and --model-arm), so the bar, which asks that arm to refuse nothing and to have every gradeable answer graded, is not met. The controls: an empty answer passes 0 of 263 rubrics, the prompt echoed back passes 0, and a refusal is graded false before any rubric runs; a parrot that answers "ok" to every prompt refuses nothing (it would meet the refusal half of the bar) and passes 0 of 263 rubrics, which is why the correct count is printed beside the refusal share. The rubrics check form and keywords, not truth: a passing answer can still be wrong in ways only a reader would see.
